thread:
eli: heads-up — incidentbot failed to page the on-call rotations for a couple alerts. customers reported delayed pages. I can see notify-proxy returning 500s to the pagerflow integration.

maria: confirmed, I'm seeing a spike of upstream timeouts in notify-proxy around 11:06 UTC. pagerflow responses are 502.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-054 (automated) :rotating_light:

jun: PD shows no trigger for two alerts; SMS fallback didn't fire. on-call didn't get any chirps.

nora: manually called on-call line, hit voicemail. escalating to manual SMS + phone tree. support is sending heads-up to affected customers. :phone:

eli: quick debug — curl to notify-proxy health:
```
$ curl -i http://notify-proxy.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: text/plain
error: upstream timeout while contacting pagerflow
```

maria: tail from notify-proxy logs (excerpt):
```
2026-06-10T11:05:58Z ERROR header_sanitizer: failed to parse signed header "x-pf-sign" -> regex match error at pos 0
2026-06-10T11:06:02Z WARN  upstream: timeout contacting pagerflow (code=504)
```
looks like header parsing regression after the signing rotation.

sam: workaround applied — flipped routing.bypass_notify_proxy -> true to route to notify-proxy-fallback endpoint. Manual page sent, on-call confirmed receipt. PD got a trigger.

deploy-bot: rolling restart initiated for service=notify-proxy sha=ab12ef (reason: header parser hotfix).

maria: after restart pages are flowing again but we observed duplicate pages for one alert (same alert id sent twice). dedupe layer didn't kick in for the fallback path.

eli: customer impact summary: two customers experienced ~5-8m delayed pages; one incident had duplicate pages after manual workaround. CS notified and drafting customer note.

jun: quick mitigation checklist: 1) keep fallback routing enabled until patch deploy completes, 2) add temporary rate limit on duplicate sends, 3) validate SMS fallback path.

nora: assigning postmortem owners — @maria and @eli. action items: verify signing rotation handling in header_sanitizer, add alert to detect notify-proxy->pagerflow 5xx spike, update runbook for manual fallback steps and ensure on-call handoff checklist includes verifying PD receipt. :memo:

sam: I'll follow up with a hotfix PR for dedupe logic and a test for the fallback codepath. tagging ops for priority.

eli: thanks — keeping this channel for live updates. please paste any PD/CS comms here. :eyes:
